ev.q: Retrospective analysis using data from jurisdictional immunization information systems was used to estimate vaccination coverage among adolescent girls
coverage with ≥1 HPV vaccine dose among adolescent girls aged 13–17 years ranged from 58.0% in Palau to 97.2% in the Northern Mariana Islands
Coverage with ≥1 HPV vaccine dose and HPV vaccination series completion status varied by jurisdiction
HPV vaccination series completion coverage increased by 35.3–72.9 percentage points
This analysis measured progress toward the WHO 2030 vaccination coverage goal
Retrospective analysis using data from jurisdictional immunization information systems was used to estimate vaccination coverage
increased each year from 2013 to 2023 in all jurisdictions except Palau

methods_quotes.q: Retrospective point-in-time analysis (i.e., coverage as of a specific date) was used to estimate vaccination coverage as of December 31 of each year during 2013–2023.
HPV vaccination series dropout was measured as the proportion of adolescents who had not completed the HPV vaccination series
Patients were excluded from all analyses if they had zero vaccine doses recorded in the IIS
